يضطغنا (form VIII)

# يُضْطَغَنَا (yuḍṭaḡanā) /judˤ.tˤa.ɣa.naː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
